import os,json
p='/home/ubuntu/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-turns/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(p,exist_ok=True)

code='''
def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_r=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and grid[r][0]!=bg]
    sep_c=[c for c in range(W) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=bg]
    def bands(n,seps):
        b=[];s=0
        for x in seps+[n]:
            if x>s: b.append((s,x))
            s=x+1
        return b
    rb=bands(H,sep_r); cb=bands(W,sep_c)
    blk=None
    for (r0,r1) in rb:
        for (c0,c1) in cb:
            if any(grid[r][c]!=bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
                blk=(r0,r1,c0,c1)
    r0,r1,c0,c1=blk
    block=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for (ra,rbnd) in rb:
        for (ca,cbnd) in cb:
            for r in range(ra,rbnd):
                for c in range(ca,cbnd):
                    out[r][c]=block[(r-ra)%len(block)][(c-ca)%len(block[0])]
    return out
'''
